value.rationale: The primary paper explicitly exhibits a strictly positive lower edge for its macroscopic core fraction, motivating the precise finite-N leakage probability. The new result supplies a continuum of nontrivial stretched-exponential population powers and identifies the rare reset-age mechanism, distinguishing correlated-gas depletion from ordinary speed-N binomial fluctuations. It is a natural sharp refinement, not an arbitrary finite invariant.
